findings.title: Wrong event listener removed in dispose
findings.body: The `dispose` method removes the `"message"` event listener bound to `this.onMessage` instead of the `"close"` event listener also bound to `this.onMessage`. This leaves the `"close"` event listener attached, which can cause the callback to run after the socket is closed and lead to undefined behavior or memory leaks. The correct listener to remove is the one bound to `"close"` and `this.onClose`.

summary.problem: The `dispose` method incorrectly removes a `"message"` event listener instead of the intended `"close"` event listener, risking memory leaks and undefined behavior.
summary.done_well: The file follows a clear structure for event listener management and cleanup.
